title: E-FRC-0132: the waiting-slot rule built as the path argued it (two waiting slots per cell, a returning orientation...

statements.text: The waiting-slot rule built as the path argued it (two waiting slots per cell, a returning orientation, local color, a paid clock and a paid move) is exact in every structural gate, but a charge that cannot pay cannot wait: in a cell where no direction can be paid, 12 of the 13 places a lone charge can be in must cross unpaid, for any number of waiting slots, so its demons go into debt.
